source: Vila et al. 2022, Nature Ecology \& Evolution 6, Fig. 3: time-calibrated maximum clade credibility tree of saltasaurid titanosaurs with ancestral-area boxes (letter codes) on every node, coloured range bars at the tips, purple age-uncertainty bars behind the nodes, a green 'latest connection' band, and a stage chart below. Image: census figure (2203x2259 px), a 300 dpi page render; re-rendered 2026-11-21 because the census's prose blanking had erased the top tip name 'Neuquensaurus'.
license: unverified: no licence statement in the text held
names_note: no matrix held; list = the printed tip names (genus only)
gold_note: Saltasaurid time tree. Branch topology read from the PDF's black vector lines (0.74 pt; the area boxes are drawn on top of them), tip names from the text layer, one per branch. Saltasauridae, Saltasaurinae, Saltasaurini, Opisthocoelicaudiinae and Lognkosauria, each printed beside its node's area box, are kept as internal labels; the area codes (EFS, S, AE, ...) are not names. 21 tips, fully resolved; 5 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Random-sample case (seed 20261114). Topology read from the PDF's own vector branch lines and checked against the figure; topology only.
